_help: Hand corrections to the wiki's Version History, applied before anything is built. Each fix: { version: 'Beta 105.0', name: card or artifact name, action: 'remove' | 'replace' | 'add', text: the whole line for replace/add, e.g. 'Clam Girl -- Cost 7 > 6.', section: optional, why: a note }. Number mistakes the patch notes already prove are fixed automatically (see data/build-log.txt).

versionHistory.name: Generous Gifts
versionHistory.why: Version History pasted Flowey's text under Generous Gifts.

versionHistory.name: Clover
versionHistory.why: Clover was New Cut Flowey renamed in Beta 94.0 (same game card, id 808; Miraheze: 'Replaced with Clover' at 94.0). In 95.0 it moved to the Undertale Yellow set, and Version History and the patch notes list it again as a new card, which made its history start at 95.0.
versionHistory.text: Clover -- Moved to the Undertale Yellow set (UTY).
